terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.preamble: By commissioning, you agree to the terms below. Terms may change without prior notice.

general.title: General
items: I reserve the right to refuse or cancel any commission for any reason.
No explicit sexual content, minors, extreme gore, heavy mecha, copied styles, or subjects I cannot portray respectfully.
Provide a clear character reference with visible base colors. Mood boards alone are not enough.
I do not design characters from scratch for YCH emote work.
Please reply promptly. If there is no reply within 3 days, the current stage is considered approved.

payments.title: Payments
items: Payments are final unless I cannot complete the commission (full refund).
Full payment upfront, except waitlist (30% non-refundable deposit).
Payment plans are available upon discussion.
Invoices must be paid within 24–48 hours or the commission is declined.

process.title: Process & revisions
items: First update is the sketch. Unlimited revisions during sketch.
After lineart begins, only minor base-color adjustments are included.
Major revisions after rendering incur extra fees based on complexity.
Typical turnaround: 7 days to 6 weeks after sketch approval, depending on queue.

deliverables.title: Deliverables
items: Files are delivered via link (Drive / VGen) after final approval.
Please download within 7 days; temporary links may expire.
PSD files are only included for animation-ready work unless agreed otherwise.

usage.title: Usage rights
items: Commercial streaming / promo use is included unless specified otherwise.
No third-party edits without approval (except planned Live2D rigging).
Not allowed: AI training, NFTs, or claiming the source as your own art.
I retain copyright and may display the work (unless an NDA applies).

nda.title: NDA options
items: Tier 1 (+30%): no WIP / showcase on socials; VGen portfolio ok.
Tier 2 (+50%): full confidentiality until you give permission.

credits.title: Credits
items: Please credit Krepe whenever possible (handles coming soon).

violations.title: Policy violations
items: Violations (unauthorized edits, AI/NFT misuse, infringement) may result in a permanent blacklist.

items.a: It opens 1–2 months before the target month. A 30% deposit reserves your slot and is deducted from the total before sketch.

items.q: Can I combine multiple items in one request?
items.a: Yes, preferred even: one proposal / invoice for the whole order.
